quarterly_data.signal: 20-F risk factors: IC substrates are prone to supply shortages because they are produced by a limited number of suppliers, such as Kinsus Interconnect Technology, Nan Ya Printed Circuit Board and Unimicron Technology; AI-driven HPC demand has raised chip and substrate design complexity, and ABF substrate may face a higher risk of supply shortages or extended lead times due to strong AI demand, manufacturing difficulty and heavy capital requirements for capacity expansion. The semiconductor equipment market is described as intense demand, limited supply and long delivery cycles.

20-F: besides the equipment vendors in the packaging chain (Tokyo Electron, Grand Process Technology, All Ring Tech), ASE purchases testers primarily from Teradyne and Advantest (as well as Tokyo Electron) and packaging equipment from Marketech International and Lam Research; it holds non-exclusive technology licence agreements with Infineon Technologies, TDK and DECA Technologies covering solder bumping, redistribution, wafer-level packaging, flip chip BGA and chip embedding, among other technologies.
